trust_center.repositoryDescription: BuildOps Trust Center (hosted on Vanta), BuildOps' FedRAMP-compatible trust center. Primary location for FedRAMP Certification Data, the SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter, remediation evidence for the SOC 2 exceptions, penetration test summary, security policies, subprocessor list, Ongoing Certification Reports, and incident reports.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Public FedRAMP information (service overview, certified services, contacts, next Ongoing Certification Report date and this Certification Package Overview in JSON and human-readable form) is open to everyone without login in BuildOps' public GitHub repository (https://github.com/BuildOps-Internal/fedramp-marketplace); the JSON is at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BuildOps-Internal/fedramp-marketplace/main/buildops-frc-cso-pkg.json. For non-public resources (SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter, penetration test summary, security policies, the Security Decision Record and Ongoing Certification Reports), select the resource and submit the access request form with your agency email. Requests from .gov, .mil and .fed.us addresses are approved automatically with no manual review and no NDA, and grant access to all Trust Center resources for 3 months; when access lapses, request again and it is approved instantly by the same rule. Programmatic access is available through the Vanta Trust Center API (https://developer.vanta.com/). BuildOps notifies FedRAMP within 5 business days of denying any agency access request (CDS-UTC-AAD). Questions: fedramp@buildops.com.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Web Application: customer, property and contact records, and the history of work for each customer and site.
Web Application: records of customer equipment and assets at each property, with service history.
Web Application: dispatching and scheduling of technicians and crews to jobs, visits and service calls.
Web Application: service jobs and recurring maintenance work from request to completion.
Web Application: construction and installation projects, including budgets, schedules, change orders and progress billing.
Web Application: operational and financial reports and dashboards on the customer's own data.
Web Application: parts and materials inventory, purchase orders and vendor bills.
Web Application: capture and approval of technician time against jobs for payroll and job costing.
Web Application: recurring maintenance contracts and the work they generate.
Add-On: sales tools on top of CRM, including quoting and proposals with delivery and approval tracking.
Add-On: vehicle and fleet tracking for field teams.
Add-On: sales opportunity and pipeline management for service and project work.
Add-On: invoicing and card and bank payment collection, processed by BuildOps' payment processor. BuildOps does not store card numbers, card security codes or full bank account numbers.
iOS and Android client used by field technicians. The installed app is a client of the in-scope cloud service; all data is processed and stored in the BuildOps cloud environment.
Integration: syncs accounting data between BuildOps and the customer's own Sage Intacct system, for customers who enable it.
Integration: syncs accounting data between BuildOps and the customer's own QuickBooks system, for customers who enable it.
Integration: syncs accounting data between BuildOps and the customer's own Viewpoint Spectrum or Vista system, for customers who enable it.
Integration: syncs accounting data between BuildOps and the customer's own NetSuite system, for customers who enable it.
Integration: syncs accounting data between BuildOps and the customer's own Sage 300 system, for customers who enable it.
Integration: the BuildOps public API and other connections the customer chooses to enable between BuildOps and its own systems.

certified.useCase: AWS US East/West (FedRAMP Certified). Primary cloud infrastructure hosting the BuildOps platform in US East (N. Virginia, us-east-1), with US East (Ohio, us-east-2) as the standby recovery region. All other third-party information resources are listed in informationResources.

current.service_desc:
BuildOps is a multi-tenant, cloud-based software platform for commercial contractors and subcontractors in the mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), and fire and life safety (FLS) industries. It provides one system for managing service and project work end to end: customer relationship management, quoting, dispatching and scheduling, field service and time tracking through web and mobile applications, service agreements, job costing, invoicing, payments, fleet management, and reporting.

The platform is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) in the US East (N. Virginia, us-east-1) region across multiple Availability Zones, with US East (Ohio, us-east-2) held as a cold-standby recovery region. All customer data is stored in the United States. AI features are off by default for federal agency tenants and are enabled only if the agency opts in. BuildOps operates the platform under an information security program independently examined in a SOC 2 Type II report against the AICPA Trust Services Criteria for Security.
